spine.claim: Newlyweds Tricia and Ethan are trapped by a blizzard in a vanished psychiatrist's secluded estate, where discovery of secret therapy tapes turns a house tour into a psychological autopsy.
Listening to Dr. Hale's recorded patient sessions breeds toxic domestic suspicion between the couple as confessions echo Ethan's own concealed background.
The dual timelines merge to reveal Dr. Hale was an imperious puppet master who manipulated vulnerable patients until boundaries turned fatal.
The perspective shatters with the realization that Tricia is not an accidental victim, but the calculated orchestrator hunting down past betrayals.
The novel inverts the true-crime voyeur: listening to other people's secrets is an indictment of the audience's own complicity and arrogance.
